summary: All 51 requirements are implemented in 15 Java files under lre/. Ten choices that the requirements did not settle are listed below. None blocks the pipeline.

issues.title: 'No obstacle' index is 0, not -1
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6/DM5/OP3/OP4 give cstc and cdyn as natural numbers but use -1 for 'no obstacle'. A nat cannot be -1.
issues.fix_directive: Kept the indices as nat. 0 is reserved for 'no obstacle' and ObstacleRegister.put rejects identifiers below 1. The sensor treats any absent identifier as 'no obstacle': safe large distance, zero fields.

issues.title: Safe large distance is 1000000.0 m
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says odist/hdist/vdist return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists, but gives no value.
issues.fix_directive: Used a private sensor constant NO_OBSTACLE_DIST = 1000000.0. It is far above every threshold (all 1 m).

issues.title: CPA formula: horizontal plane, closing velocity, epsilon in the denominator
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa but gives no formula. The sensor exposes only horizontal relative position and velocity accessors.
issues.fix_directive: With r = (nsRelDist, ewRelDist) and c = AUV velocity minus obstacle velocity: tcpa = r.c / (|c|^2 + 0.000001) and cda = sqrt(hdist^2 - tcpa^2 |c|^2). Using hdist makes cda the large distance when there is no dynamic obstacle, and the epsilon keeps tcpa defined when |c| = 0. Obstacle depth and rate of climb do not enter the CPA.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ re-selects the closest static obstacle through the sensor
issues.raw: LRE-OP2 says CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc. The operation profile allows only sensor calls and the class's own fields in compute().
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ evaluates sensor.odist(sensor.closestStaticIndex()). This is the same selection CalcCStc makes in the same step, so the value is identical. CalcCPA does the same for cdyn through its field dynIdx.

issues.title: Transition priority: autonomous safety transitions before operator events
issues.raw: The requirements give no priority among a mode's transitions. The preflight check (rule8) reports that an event branch placed above a branch with no event has no RoboChart counterpart, because RoboChart has no guard for an absent event.
issues.fix_directive: In MOM, HCM and CAM, the branches with no event come first: inOpez, then collision course, then the static-obstacle changes. The operator events follow, each conjoined with the negation of every guard above it. So in MOM and HCM, reqOCM, endTask and reqHCM take effect only when no autonomous guard holds. In CAM, reqOCM (Beh17) applies only while cda < minSafeDist; otherwise Beh18 already leads to OCM. In MOM the HCM branches are ordered Beh9, Beh11, Beh10. Beh10 placed before Beh11 would make Beh11's guard unsatisfiable while both vertical thresholds are 1.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) or 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: The system description says HCM runs at a reduced speed of 0.1 m/s. LRE-FR3 says that on entering HCM the LRE advises 0 m/s.
issues.fix_directive: Followed LRE-FR3: every branch into HCM issues advVel(0.0).

issues.title: LRE-Beh4 thresholds written as the literal 1
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 requires vel <= 1, odist(cdyn) > 1 and odist(cstc) > 1. The distance '1' might be minSafeDist, whose default is also 1.
issues.fix_directive: Used the literal 1.0 that the requirement states. If the distances were meant to be minSafeDist, replace 1.0 with LreConstants.MIN_SAFE_DIST in dynObsBeyondOne and staticObsBeyondOne.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1 sets vvel to the rate of climb, and LRE-Beh11 tests vvel >= 1. A fast descent toward a static obstacle below therefore does not satisfy Beh11.
issues.fix_directive: Followed the requirement literally (vvel = rateOfClimb, no absolute value). Beh10 covers a close static obstacle regardless of velocity.

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre not specified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres in CAM but defines no output for them. LRE-DM7 allows only advVel and advHdng.
issues.fix_directive: Entering CAM issues no output. CAM is left on reqOCM (Beh17) or when cda >= minSafeDist (Beh18, advVel(0)).

issues.title: Variables live in the operation classes; no-event cycles pass null
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..8 say the controller maintains the variables. The profile builds guard predicates from operation calls, and model names must be unique. LRE-DM6 defines no 'no event' input.
issues.fix_directive: Each variable is a field of the operation that computes it. The controller runs every operation at the start of step() and reads the values through getters in its predicates. A cycle with no operator input calls step(null).

next_step: Run the pipeline. Revisit an item only if a verifier or the operator rejects the choice.
